canaries.name: G1 entropy
canaries.detail: final entropy 1.343 nats is 75% of the uniform ceiling 1.792 -- near-uniform, so the policy has probably not learned to discriminate between targets. Every overnight failure looked like this.

canaries.name: G3 informative fraction
canaries.detail: 99.9% of scored actions were ones the oracle had a preference about; agreement numbers rest on a real sample.

canaries.name: G4 seed spread
canaries.detail: gap closed spans 1.068 across 3 seeds (-2.515 to -1.447) -- above the 0.50 limit, so the median is not a safe summary. Treat this configuration as unstable rather than as good.

canaries.name: G5 gate 1 recorded
canaries.detail: observational-only rate 0.0400 against a singleton fraction of 0.0893 -- GATE 1 FAILED, so this environment does not match its specification and the results below describe a different task than intended.
